mechanism: Both drugs affect cardiovascular regulation and CNS function; clonidine is an alpha-2 agonist causing hypotension and bradycardia while varenicline is a partial nicotinic agonist that may increase sympathomimetic activity, creating opposing hemodynamic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; counsel patient on smoking cessation goals and watch for hypertensive episodes or paradoxical hemodynamic responses; dose adjustment may be needed.
